description: Evaluations for self-learning-feedback skill using ANALYSIS SWARM 3-persona pattern (skill-independent versioning per ADR-024)

evals.prompt: Verify skill has all 4 modules: verify (RYAN), score (FLASH), learn (SOCRATES), improve (SYNTHESIS)
evals.expected_output: All 4 module files exist in modules/ directory

evals.prompt: Verify skill version is valid semver (skill-independent from product VERSION per ADR-024), not empty
evals.expected_output: Skill version is valid semver like 0.1.6

evals.prompt: Verify evals.json version tracks owning SKILL.md version (skill-independent policy)
Test verify module can run version check in skill-independent mode
evals.expected_output: Verify script runs and reports source version

evals.prompt: Test score module can score a markdown file for noise level
Test learn module can capture a lesson from a version mismatch error
evals.command: bash .agents/skills/self-learning-feedback/scripts/capture_lesson.sh --error-type version_mismatch --context test --evidence test --fix test --dry-run 2>/dev/null || test -f .agents/skills/self-learning-feedback/scripts/capture_lesson.sh

evals.prompt: Test improve module can synthesize RYAN, FLASH, SOCRATES inputs into fix recommendations
Use skill to ensure no stale v1.0.0 template defaults remain in product docs outside skills
evals.expected_output: No v1.0.0 claims in product docs; skill-independent verification passes
criteria: No v1.0.0 claims outside .agents/skills/ (grep -r v1.0.0 --include=*.md | grep -v .agents/skills/ is empty)
Skill SKILL.md version is valid semver
